step1.text:
Web Search: Web search: live web search API and SERP API for AI agents. Search the web and get ranked results as clean JSON (title, URL, snippet, score, domain, publish date), 1-10 per call, like a SERP or search engine API.
Price: $0.003 per call, paid by this machine's wallet straight to the provider.
Request: POST https://api.agentsearchhq.com/x402/v1/search
Inputs:
- query (string, required); Search query in natural language or keywords.
- country (string); 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to localise results, e.g. us, gb, de.
- date_from (string); Earliest publish date, YYYY-MM-DD.; format date
- date_to (string); Latest publish date, YYYY-MM-DD.; format date
- exclude_domains (array of string); Never return results from these domains, up to 5.
- freshness (string); Only results from the past day, week, month or year. Do not combine with date_from/date_to.; one of "day", "week", "month", "year"
- include_domains (array of string); Only return results from these domains (subdomains included), up to 5.
- language (string); ISO 639-1 interface language, e.g. en, es or pt-BR.
- max_results (integer); Maximum number of results (1-10).
To run it, call request({id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008", input: {...}}) with the inputs above. Nothing has been paid.
Also offered: Web search API (the Brave-based one, GET https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/search/web) and Agent Rest Stop (web search API).
step1.earlier_pick: On the first try of the same query (2026-11-24) the router picked the Brave-based Web search API (GET https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/search/web, $0.01, inputs q, count, includeDomains as a comma list or JSON array, startPublishedDate). Its response is not recorded.

observed: The same `site:` query went to two different web search APIs on two days, so the `web_search` mapper must accept more than one supplier: match on the result shape (a `results[]` array of objects with `url` and `title`), not on one host. This supplier takes `include_domains` as an array of at most 5 and `max_results` of at most 10; the other takes `includeDomains` and `count`. The envelope has no `label`. `published_date` comes as "Nov 13, 2026" or "6 days ago", so code must not rely on its format and must confirm each job on its board. All 3 results were direct Greenhouse or Ashby postings, the kind the JSearch run never returned.
